detail.title: Non-contact robot gripper
detail.abstract: The invention provides a non-contact robot gripper, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical grippers. A non-contact robot gripper comprises a robot, a frame and a plurality of non-contact suckers; according to the invention, the arm of the robot is connected with the frame with the non-contact type suckers, the annular groove and the third channel which is tangentially arranged along the side wall of the groove and communicated with the groove are arranged at the bottom of the sucker main body of the non-contact type sucker, so that gas can flow out from the third channel along the tangential direction of the side wall of the concave cavity and form spiral motion under the constraint of the inner wall of the concave cavity, and vacuum suction is generated, the glass substrate is adsorbed, grabbed and transferred under the condition of not contacting the glass substrate, the problems of surface pollution, scratch, damage and deformation caused by contact are avoided, the quality of the glass substrate is ensured, the requirement of subsequent processing is met, and the production and manufacturing of the glass substrate are more facilitated.
